Remark
[Classification of covers for the product splitting] ↗ cor:global-product-splitting-cover

The possible cover is trivial, a normal $\Zee $-cover, a two-sheeted cover, or a normal infinite-dihedral cover; the last two carry only a non-orientable null line field.

Proposition
[Non-flat cones do not arise from non-negatively curved Ricci flow]
